#include <iostream>
#include <string>

class Solver {
private:
    std::string s;
    int n;

public:
    Solver(std::string str, int length) : s(str), n(length) {}

    int maxLengthOutside() {
        int max = -1;
        int cur = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = s[i];
            if (c == '_') {
                if (cur > max) max = cur;
                cur = 0;
            } else if (c != '(' && c != ')') {
                cur++;
            } else {
                if (cur > max) max = cur;
                cur = 0;
                i++;
                while (s[i] != ')') {
                    i++;
                }
            }
        }
        if (cur > max) max = cur;
        return max;
    }

    int countWordsInParentheses() {
        int words = 0;
        int cur = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            while (i < n && s[i] != '(') {
                i++;
            }
            if (i == n) {
                break;
            }
            i++;
            while (s[i] != ')') {
                if (s[i] == '_') {
                    if (cur > 0) {
                        words++;
                    }
                    cur = 0;
                } else {
                    cur++;
                }
                i++;
            }
            if (cur > 0) {
                words++;
            }
            cur = 0;
        }
        return words;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string input;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> input;
    Solver solver(input, n);
    std::cout << solver.maxLengthOutside() << " " << solver.countWordsInParentheses() << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
